source.title: The ecology, subsistence and diet of ~45,000-year-old Homo sapiens at Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, Germany
source.authors: Smith, G.M.; Ruebens, K.; Zavala, E.I.; et al.
source.version: Nature Ecology & Evolution 8(3):564–577; version of record published 2024-01-31
source.locator: Abstract; Main, Ilsenhöhle stratigraphy and LRJ layers 9–8
source.scope: Primary zooarchaeology, palaeoproteomics, sediment DNA and stable-isotope study at Ilsenhöhle, Ranis, Germany. The human diet inference is limited to the 10 sampled human remains and their archaeological context.
source.licenseAppliesTo: The article is identified as CC BY 4.0; third-party material may have separate credit-line terms. The dossier and app use paraphrased facts only and reproduce no article text, figures, third-party material or data files.
source.attribution: Smith et al. (2024), Nature Ecology & Evolution 8:564–577, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41559-023-02303-6.

claim.text: Stable-isotope analysis of collagen from 10 human remains, interpreted with 52 animal remains at Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, indicated a homogeneous dietary signal based on large terrestrial mammals in a cold steppe–tundra setting. This claim applies to the sampled early Homo sapiens and this cave assemblage; it does not describe the diet of Homo sapiens generally.
claim.textZh: 对 Ilsenhöhle 的 10 份人类遗骸胶原蛋白进行稳定同位素分析，并结合 52 份动物遗骸，研究指出当地早期 Homo sapiens 的饮食信号较为同质，主要来自大型陆生哺乳动物，环境为寒冷草原／苔原。此主张仅适用于该洞穴考古组合及被采样个体，不代表 Homo sapiens 的普遍饮食。
claim.locator: Abstract; Main, Ranis and LRJ layers 9–8; stable-isotope summary for 52 animal and 10 human remains
claim.placeTimeScope: Ilsenhöhle at Ranis, Thuringia, central Germany. The sampled human remains are associated with LRJ layers 9–8 dated respectively to 47,500–45,770 and 46,820–43,260 calibrated years BP; these are archaeological layer ages, not direct dates on every human specimen.
claim.lifeStatus: Ancient human remains attributed to Homo sapiens in an archaeological cave context; this does not describe living, wild or captive populations.

gaps: This isotope inference concerns 10 human remains at one cave and does not establish a general Homo sapiens diet, habitat profile or range-wide ecological pattern.

The article reports fluctuating human presence, sparse human butchery traces and substantial cave-bear and hyena input to the cave assemblage; isotope results alone do not show that every indicated animal taxon was hunted or consumed at the site.

appProfile.value: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, collagen isotopes from 10 human remains, interpreted with 52 animal remains, indicated a large-terrestrial-mammal diet in a cold steppe–tundra setting. This single cave sample does not describe Homo sapiens generally.
appProfile.valueZh: 在德国 Ranis 的 Ilsenhöhle，10 份人类遗骸胶原蛋白同位素结果结合 52 份动物遗骸，显示其饮食信号主要来自大型陆生哺乳动物，环境为寒冷草原／苔原。该单一洞穴样本不代表 Homo sapiens 的普遍饮食。

source.title: Effect of human feeding on the road mortality of Rhesus Macaques on National Highway-7 routed along Pench Tiger Reserve, Madhya Pradesh, India
source.locator: Abstract; Methods, Roadkill data collection; Results, Roadkills
source.license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported; article front matter also states non-profit reuse with attribution
source.scope: Primary one-year field study of rhesus macaque distribution, roadside feeding and road mortality along one 11-km NH-7 segment in the Kanha–Pench corridor, Madhya Pradesh, India.
source.licenseVersion: CC BY 3.0 Unported; paper-specific front matter states non-profit reuse with attribution
source.licenseAppliesTo: The article front page identifies CC BY 3.0 Unported and states that JoTT allows non-profit reuse with attribution. The dossier and app paraphrase factual findings and reproduce no article text, figures or tables.
source.attribution: Pragatheesh, A. (2011), Journal of Threatened Taxa 3(4):1656–1662, https://doi.org/10.11609/JoTT.o2669.1656-62.

claim.text: On an 11-km NH-7 segment through the Kanha–Pench corridor beside Pench Tiger Reserve in Madhya Pradesh, India, roadkill monitoring recorded 54 Macaca mulatta deaths from August 2009 to July 2010 (27 in summer, 19 in winter and 8 during monsoon). Within this single study, seasonal roadkill counts were positively correlated with traffic intensity, and the highest roadkill hotspot overlapped a location with frequent roadside feeding. These observations do not estimate a population-level mortality rate, establish causation, or describe present-day or range-wide conservation status.
claim.textZh: 在印度中央邦、毗邻奔奇虎保护区并穿越 Kanha–Pench 廊道的 NH-7 一段 11 公里路段，研究人员于 2009 年 8 月至 2010 年 7 月的路杀监测中记录了 54 只恒河猴死亡（夏季 27 只、冬季 19 只、季风期 8 只）。在这项单点研究中，季节路杀数量与交通强度呈正相关，最高路杀热点与频繁路边投喂地点重合。这些观察不能估算种群死亡率、证明因果关系，也不代表现今或全分布区的保育状况。
claim.locator: Abstract; Methods, Roadkill data collection; Results, Roadkills
claim.placeTimeScope: One 11-km NH-7 segment between Kurai and Gandatola along the eastern boundary of Pench Tiger Reserve and through the Kanha–Pench corridor, Madhya Pradesh, India; roadkill monitoring from August 2009 to July 2010, twice daily in early morning and late evening. Seasonal counts were 27 in summer, 19 in winter and 8 during monsoon.
claim.lifeStatus: Free-ranging macaques occupying roadside habitat in the study area; this is not a captive cohort or a range-wide population sample.

gaps: A single road segment and one year of roadside carcass monitoring do not establish a population-level mortality rate, population impact, present-day mortality or a range-wide threat trend; no detection or carcass-persistence correction is reported.

The study does not assign a formal conservation category. Correlation with traffic intensity and overlap with roadside-feeding hotspots are observational associations and do not establish a causal mechanism.

appProfile.value: One-year monitoring of an 11-km NH-7 segment near Pench recorded 54 rhesus macaque road deaths in 2009–2010 (27 summer, 19 winter, 8 monsoon). Local associations with traffic and roadside feeding do not establish population mortality or current/global conservation status.
appProfile.valueZh: 2009–2010 年，奔奇附近一段 11 公里 NH-7 路段的一年监测记录 54 只恒河猴路杀（夏季 27 只、冬季 19 只、季风期 8 只）。当地路杀与交通量及路边投喂的关联不能确立种群死亡率或现今／全球保育状况。
